title: Timed storyboard check
summary: Checks a timed storyboard's structure (required story fields, contiguous shots from 0, shot count, duration) and prints the storyboard-gate review sheet with every answer starting as not checked.
evidence_notes: Its pytest suite (12 focused positive and negative checks, run against the guide's Decoy Job board and Front Legs pitch) passed in the generator's container on 2026-10-10. It has not been used on a production board. It checks structure only, never story quality.
